statement_blocker: Smale 1967 item (6.1) defines Axiom A as a property of a compact-manifold diffeomorphism rather than asserting a theorem. Selecting an equivalence or consequence as the proof target would substitute the catalog item without an approved source-backed redirection.
domain_and_universes: Source boundary: a connected compact C^r manifold M under Smale's standing conventions and a C^r diffeomorphism f : M -> M, with 1 <= r <= infinity; hyperbolicity additionally uses a Riemannian-manifold tangent bundle. Open formal decisions include universes, boundary convention, exact model-with-corners and metric/norm structures, and the encoding of the nonwandering subset.
conclusion: Open: the source gloss gives a definition label and states no truth-valued conclusion about Axiom A systems.
